title: Registration form (participant <-> frontend, UI)
description: Field model of the single-page form. x-label is the visible label; x-testid is the element's data-testid; every field has an error element data-testid='error-<field>'. The type selector switches the type-specific fields (AC-002-09). Client checks mirror the backend (NFR-03) and backend field errors are shown at the same elements. On 201 the form is replaced by data-testid='confirmation' (BR-06); on 400/409 the entered values are kept; on other errors data-testid='form-error' shows a general message.

optionIds.x-label: checkbox per active option offered to the selected type, data-testid='option-<id>'

recaptchaToken.x-label: reCAPTCHA widget, or in test mode a checkbox 'Test mode: I am not a robot'

x-messages.INVALID_CHARACTERS: This value contains characters that are not allowed.
x-messages.CONSENT_REQUIRED: You must give this consent to register.
x-messages.RECAPTCHA_FAILED: Please confirm that you are not a robot.
x-messages.OPTION: This option is not available. Reload the page and choose again.
x-messages.DUPLICATE_EMAIL: This email address is already registered. Please contact the organizers.
x-messages.GENERAL: Your registration could not be processed. Please try again later.
x-messages.CONFIRMATION: Thank you, your registration has been received.
